visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: inherits section (design pass: yellow quotation mark and quote text)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Round portrait image on the left, large opening quotation mark above the quote text, attribution (bold name, role) below the quote; portrait stacks above the quote on mobile

contentPattern: Row 1: portrait image | quote text. Row 2: attribution (bold name, role). Cells may be in either order; without a second row a trailing paragraph starting with bold text or a dash is the attribution; the portrait is optional
